title: Old Friendship
note: He defines this as bearing the faults of friends because they are old friends. It follows the testing of friends because even tested friends have faults, and fate too makes them err.

couplets.plain: What is old friendship? It is friendship that in no way cuts back the rights of closeness.
couplets.pm: Old friendship is friendship that in no way stops what an old friend does by right, and agrees to it. Such acts are doing your work without asking, even doing it harm, taking what he needs, and showing no deference or fear. So old friendship isn’t a matter of time gone by, but of friendship of this kind.
couplets.sensitive: urges submitting without resentment to a loved one’s liberties

links.quote: friendship that in no way cuts back the rights of closeness
links.reason: Defines old friendship as the kind that in no way cuts back the rights of closeness.

couplets.plain: The rights of closeness are a limb of friendship. To be its salt is the duty of the worthy.
couplets.pm: What friends do by right are limbs of friendship, not something apart from it. So it is the proper way of the worthy to be pleasant about those rights. He names the worthy because they know these are limbs of friendship, and so stay sweet.
couplets.note: உப்பு is literally salt, and he reads it as being pleasant.

links.quote: The rights of closeness are a limb of friendship
links.reason: Makes the rights of closeness a limb of friendship itself.

couplets.plain: What use is long friendship if you can’t accept what a friend does by right, as if you had done it yourself?
couplets.pm: What use is a friendship grown old if you don’t agree, as if you had done it yourself, to what friends do by right, even what you wouldn’t otherwise accept? Agreeing in this way means agreeing by the same right you have with them.
couplets.sensitive: presses one to accept whatever liberties a friend takes

couplets.plain: When friends, out of closeness, act without asking, people welcome it as something to be wished for.
couplets.pm: When friends do your work by right, without asking, the wise want that act for how desirable it is. Nothing is better than finding your work done without knowing it. Only the wise see it so and want it, so he says it of them.

links.quote: act without asking, people welcome it
links.reason: A friend’s unasked act, done out of closeness, is welcomed as something to wish for.

links.quote: When friends, out of closeness, act without asking

links.remove: The love and the letting pass are the old English. The Tamil speaks of friends acting unasked, not of a friend who has hurt you.

couplets.plain: If friends do something that hurts, put it down to foolishness or to great closeness.
couplets.pm: If friends do what you could resent, put it down to foolishness or to great closeness. It isn’t their nature. Everyone has the folly that comes from the fate of loss, so they have only harmed themselves. Or what fate would have sent by your hand has come by theirs, because you are so much one. Never take it as lack of loving-kindness.
couplets.sensitive: tells the hurt to explain away a friend’s harm

links.quote: If friends do something that hurts
put it down to foolishness or to great closeness

couplets.plain: Those who keep to the bounds of friendship don’t leave those who have stood by them from of old, even in ruin.
couplets.pm: Those who keep within the limit of friendship don’t give up the bond with those who have stayed unchanged in old closeness, even when ruin has come through them. The ruin is loss of wealth or loss in war.
couplets.sensitive: praises staying with someone who ruined you

links.quote: don’t leave those who have stood by them from of old, even in ruin
links.reason: Even ruin does not end the bond for those who keep to the bounds of friendship.

couplets.plain: Even if friends do what ruins them, those whose bond has come down through loving-kindness don’t lose their loving-kindness.
couplets.pm: Even if friends do what brings ruin on them, those whose friendship has grown old with loving-kindness don’t give up their loving-kindness for them. The ruin is the same as before. Even when someone does you harm, the friendship isn’t to be given up.
couplets.sensitive: praises loving on through repeated harm

links.reason: Long loving-kindness does not slacken, even when a friend does ruinous things.

couplets.plain: For those so close that they won’t hear of a friend’s fault, the day the friend does wrong is a good day.
couplets.pm: For those who know the right of closeness, and won’t accept a friend’s fault even when others report it, the day that friend does wrong is a day well used. The faults are taking good things without a word and showing no deference or fear. Only such an act shows that closeness, so days without one don’t count as days.
couplets.sensitive: calls a friend’s injury a cause for celebration

links.quote: the day the friend does wrong is a good day
links.reason: So deep is the closeness that the day a friend does wrong becomes a good day.

couplets.plain: The world desires those who don’t give up the friendship of those whose bond has come down unbroken.
couplets.pm: The world wants as friends those who, seeing faults, don’t drop the friendship of those whose closeness has stayed whole from of old. Everyone thinks they will be like that with them too, and comes to them as friends. Some read a different word, and take it as those unfailing in friendship.

links.quote: The world desires those who don’t give up
links.reason: Not giving up an old friend wins the desire of the whole world.

couplets.plain: Those who don’t part from their good nature towards old friends are desired even by those who don’t desire them.
couplets.pm: Those who keep their own nature towards old friends, even when those friends do wrong, are wanted even by enemies. Their nature is to keep the loving-kindness they had before the wrong was done. Seeing that they don’t change, even enemies become friends.

links.quote: desired even by those who don’t desire them
